content.comment_body: How many computers can connect at the same time via [product_name] and IP through the web interface? I'm trying to access from two devices, but only one is successful. Is this due to configuration or is access limited to a single user at a time?

From my experience: Only one connection to the extended web server usually works reliably, and it depends heavily on the browser used. Occasionally, more than one connection is possible, but this often leads to problems. For an official answer from [company_name], consider submitting a support request.

Hello, in general, [product_name] supports up to 8 simultaneous connections. In theory, up to 8 devices can link to the web server. The main issue involves web browsers, which usually open multiple connections per device. As far as I know, only Firefox allows you to set the channels to one, but the setting is reset after browser updates, so it's not a perfect solution. For mobile devices (Android and iOS), I haven't found any way to reduce the browser channels. Hope this information is useful.
Greetings. I have managed to connect with four devices at the same time. I haven't tried more.

Hello [user_name], please try to post your question in English, as this is an international community and responses are generally in English. This translation of your reply should help you get better feedback. Best regards.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are trying to connect multiple devices to the [product_name] web server via [product_name], but they encounter limitations with concurrent connections. Browser handling seems to affect the number of successful simultaneous accesses even though theoretically multiple connections should be supported.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the [product_name] device to provide dependable access to multiple simultaneous web connections from several computers or devices, as described by [company_name], and want detailed guidance regarding any possible configuration restrictions.
